title: Find another angle with same position
text: Notice that $$-\frac{9\pi}{4}$$ is more negative than one full rotation backwards. We can add $$2\pi$$ (which is equivalent to $$\frac{8\pi}{4}$$ )to find to find a simpler angle on the primary unit circle that is at the same position.

title: Evaluate the special value
text: Recall your unit circle. The angle $$-\frac{\pi}{4}$$ is in the fourth quadrant, where the $$x\$\$-coordinate$$ $$is$$ $$positive$$. $$The$$ $$x\$\$-coordinate$$ $$(cosine)$$ $$at$$ $$this$$ $$angle$$ $$is$$ $$\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$$.
